name: Spike - quitting a weekend mid-session
notes: The last thing the resumable weekend state machine needs. A clean close from the results screen is already known to write one entry per session run; this is the harsh variant nobody chooses on purpose - the player who binds off mid-race. Let practice and qualifying run out, start the race, drive a lap, then ESC and quit out of the session. The point is that two sessions completed before the abort, so we learn whether AC preserves them. Check `npm run results -- --live` BEFORE launching as well as after: if AC writes nothing, the live file still holds the previous capture, and the only way to tell that apart from a fresh write is to know what was there first. The drivers here are named Quit 1 to Quit 5 for exactly that reason - see those names and the file is new, see anything else and AC wrote nothing. Note also that `npm run race` will sit waiting on a result that may never arrive, so expect to Ctrl+C it and read the live file yourself. If the two completed sessions survive, a bundle can resume from what AC leaves behind; if nothing is written, a launch is atomic and we must archive after each one ourselves.
